title: Solo dev here. My browser arena FPS is almost ready for beta, here's the first look at BLOCKRIFT.
author: Ditex_Design

comments.author: Ditex_Design
comments.body: Hey all! BLOCKRIFT is a fast arena shooter that runs in a browser tab, no download or install. What's in it so far: - Slide-hop movement, built to feel fast - 5 classes, each with its own character - Team Deathmatch and Gun Game, with a zombies survival mode in the works - Server-authoritative multiplayer The clip is from a solo test match against bots, so don't judge my aim too hard. Beta is close. It'll be free to play at blockrift.io. I'd love feedback on two things: does the movement look fun, and does the gunplay look like it has enough punch?
